text.tspan: Hold SW2 at power-up = download mode.
Press in normal use = admin/setup mode.
1. Pin numbers per ESP32-C6-WROOM-1 datasheet. Check against the current Espressif datasheet before PCB layout.
2. Strapping pins: IO8 (pull-up), IO9 (pull-up + button), IO15 (open), IO4/IO5 (expansion; IO4 has a 10k pull-down on sheet 9).
3. Keep the PCB-antenna end of U3 over the board edge with no copper underneath, away from the relay and XL7015.
4. Use the -1U variant + u.FL pigtail when the box is on a metal gate or Zigbee range must be extended.
